title: Charging access and station usability
summary: Feedback about charging centers on public-station speed and home plug flexibility in positive reviews, while negative reviews cite station-finder controls and charge-port access problems, and many other mentions are too fragmentary to classify.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise fast public charging and the ability to charge from either 110V or 220V outlets.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe disappointment with the charging-station display button and charge-door flap lockups that prevent plugging in.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions include requests for more or better-located charging stations, adapter and connector questions, charging-speed wishes, and fragments too incomplete to assign sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most topic mentions are undetermined, so the sample provides limited direct evidence about clear sentiment.
The sampled fragments include both vehicle charging behavior and public charging infrastructure or app/navigation issues, which broadens the topic beyond a single feature.
Several fragments are incomplete or lack enough context to determine whether the customer experience was positive, negative, or merely informational.
